Theorem
[Kähler Type II models are steady solitons] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 4.3.8\group Cao–Zhu Limiting Singularity Models

  • Any Type II singularity model on a Kähler manifold with nonnegative holomorphic bisectional curvature and positive Ricci curvature must be a steady Kähler-Ricci soliton.

  • Any Type III singularity model on a Kähler manifold with nonnegative holomorphic bisectional curvature and positive Ricci curvature must be an expanding Kähler-Ricci soliton.
